name: Research Reviewer Rejected — Retry with source-acquisition
description: When the research-reviewer emits decide(action=insufficient), respawn the researcher-with-source-acquisition role to address the reviewer's gaps. The researcher-with-source-acquisition persona reads the reason via read_loop_result and decides whether the gap is a corpus gap (call add_source_repo) or a search gap (re-query). This is the structural test of the ADR-031 invariant: research can modify the substrate it's reasoning over. Bounded by max_iterations=5; same caveat as R1's analogue rule about per-entity rule-state keying. R2.5 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research-with-source-retry
on_enter.prompt: Prior reviewer reported gaps. Reviewer loop id: $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to read the gaps list (the reviewer's decide reason field), then decide whether the gap is a corpus gap (call add_source_repo first, then iterate) or a search gap (re-query the existing corpus). Emit a completion containing the updated artifact JSON, populating addressed_gaps with the gaps you covered (including any source registration) and open_gaps with anything you could not resolve.

metadata.stop_condition: Q2 — MaxIter (=5) + reviewer + opt-in human gate
metadata.max_iterations_note: Same per-entity rule-state caveat as R1's rule 02. Each reviewer loop is a new entity, so the budget is informational; mock-llm fixture sequence determines termination in this e2e.
